name: 44870 · Sandusky, OH
findings: ZIP 44870 (Sandusky) has 211 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44870 (Sandusky) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44870 (Sandusky) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
